checkedAlternates.risk: In Chinese, Altocumulus is called 高積雲, sounding like high cloud.
checkedAlternates.resolution: In WMO classification, Alto- clouds are middle-level (2–7 km, group-2), whereas Cirro- clouds are high-level (group-3).
Nimbostratus is a low-to-middle layered rain cloud (group-4), whereas Cumulonimbus is a towering vertical storm cloud (group-1).
